name: Unraid-Template-Sync
description: Receives authenticated GitHub push webhooks and automatically refreshes this Unraid server's private Community Applications XML templates.

paths.name: Managed template repository
paths.description: Managed docker-templates-unraid checkout. The service clones it automatically when this directory is empty; tracked changes and, when enabled, untracked files are discarded during sync.

paths.name: Private template destination
paths.description: Destination for the mirrored Lowess XML templates. Stale XML files are deleted; non-XML files are left untouched.

ports.name: Webhook HTTP port
ports.description: HTTP port consumed by Nginx Proxy Manager. Do not expose it directly to the internet.

variables.name: GitHub Webhook Secret
variables.description: Required high-entropy secret shared with the GitHub repository webhook. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: GitHub Repository
variables.description: Only webhook payloads for this exact owner/repository are accepted.

variables.name: GitHub Branch
variables.description: Only pushes to this branch start a sync.

variables.name: Git HTTPS URL
variables.description: Public HTTPS Git URL used for fetches; no host SSH keys are mounted.

variables.name: Clean untracked repository files
variables.description: Run git clean -fd after reset, matching the previous script. Disable only if this checkout intentionally contains untracked files.

variables.name: Sync on container start
variables.description: Reconcile templates at startup to recover from missed webhook deliveries.
